# 02 · The Wild Frontier
The steppe as a harvest: camps found, cleared, tamed. **Ruled Æra I–II only**; its heir is
The Steppes (15), and Wolf-Mother's tamed horde is the bridge.

## Æra I
- Tech: — (the wild needs none)
- Orders: Camp Followers · Border Ballads · Spoils of the Wild · Wolf-Runners
- Religion: Lady of the Hunt (pantheon)
- Deeds: ▢ ________ (a camp-count feat — first to clear three?)

## Æra II
- Doctrines: Wolf-Mother's Pact (the flip: the wild joins you)
- Orders: ▢ ________ (one farewell card — the last hunt)
- Deeds: ▢ ________ (the farewell deed: end the age holding a tamed horde?)
- The handoff: the horde, the camp habits and the hunt line hand to 15 (The Steppes).

## Gaps
Deliberately none to fill past II — resist the urge.
